name: Coastal birds
description: Seabirds - breeders and migrants that crowd the Banc's mudflats, the largest wintering ground for Palearctic wading birds in Africa. Their food is unmistakably Banc-made: three quarters of the diet is Banc-d'Arguin benthos (crabs, molluscs, worms) and sardinelles - the highest dependency on the Banc of any predator in the model. Functional group pooling the source's single coastal-birds compartment, which groups the region's seabird species measured together.
